description: Address review findings: replace MagicMock with owned fakes in client tests, add REPL tests, remove redundant conftest state, centralize transport fakes, improve coverage
steps: Create tests/fakes/transport.py with FakeStreamingBody, FakeBotoClient, FakeClientError, FakeUrlResponse for reuse across client tests
Refactor tests/client/test_agentcore.py to use FakeBotoClient instead of MagicMock scaffolding
Refactor tests/client/test_local.py sync tests to use FakeUrlResponse instead of MagicMock context managers
Refactor tests/cli/test_commands.py to avoid asserting on mock call counts - use fakes with flags instead
Remove redundant state initialization from test_client fixture in tests/conftest.py
Add tests/client/test_repl.py with tests for run_repl: exit on empty input, stream_fn called with correct args, KeyboardInterrupt handled, slash commands /exit /quit /session /help /clear
acceptance_criteria: No MagicMock scaffolding in test_agentcore.py for boto3 sessions/clients
No MagicMock context managers in test_local.py for urlopen
No redundant state initialization in conftest.py test_client fixture
FakeStreamingBody and FakeBotoClient live in tests/fakes/transport.py
REPL module has test coverage (tests/client/test_repl.py exists with meaningful tests)
uv run just test passes with coverage >= 70%
